scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll', ''); fs.writeFileSync('out/CNAME', 'app.hillel818.org\n'); const pages = ['kiosk', 'events', 'profile', 'developer', 'register']; pages.forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync('out/' + p + '/index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('out/' + p + '/index.html', 'out/' + p + '.html'); }); fs.copyFileSync('out/index.html', 'out/404.html'); console.log('Created .nojekyll, CNAME, static .html aliases, and SPA 404.html fallback');"
